goal: Ship the Auto-approval lane (#631): an Autopilot-tier batch auto-approves as approval_method='auto_policy' at build completion behind SOLICITATION_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED, with the D9 60-minute veto window anchored on the first confirmed-delivered veto notice, fail-closed.
non_goals: Per-ask Judge verdicts — spec: '#631 must not grow a verdict path' (§9.4 deferred)
Staging/prod flag flips and flip evidence — #633 owns the flips; #631 lands inert (flag unset everywhere)
Changing BATCH_CAP=25 or making it owner-adjustable (D20: asymmetric by design)
Retroactive auto-approval of batches built before the flag flip — decision runs at build time only
New analytics events — matches #629 precedent; observability is spine + release report + Sentry
user_visible_behavior: A built batch on an account with SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED + SOLICITATION_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED, tierGrantsAutopilot, a persona='solicitation' policy row, and no Governor suspension on any account policy row is approved as auto_policy inside the build transaction; the owner sees it in the veto window, never in pending review
The owner receives a veto notice on enrolled channels; the veto window (30/60 min per policy, default 60) starts at the FIRST confirmed delivery, not at approval
The owner can halt the batch (owner_veto) during the veto window on the existing Requests surface; admins via the admin surface

The releaser re-checks the auto conditions for unreleased auto_policy batches each tick; auto flag off, Autopilot tier lost, policy row gone, or suspension latched ⇒ downgradeApproval to owner review with a mirrored reason vocabulary (auto_approval_disabled | autopilot_entitlement_lost | policy_removed | policy_suspended)

/settings/auto-approval gains a Solicitation section: opt-in toggle (creates/removes the persona='solicitation' account-default row), daily_send_cap dial (1..50), veto window dial (30 or 60, default 60) — API-driven state, both server flags gate visibility
invariants: Invariant #3 analog (spec §Invariants table): no email leaves without approval_method IN ('owner','auto_policy'); the auto lane additionally requires tier + both flags + Judge availability + delivered-notice veto window
D9 fail-closed: no delivered veto notice ⇒ veto_deadline_at stays NULL ⇒ the releaser never releases; the batch terminalizes by the existing expiry closure — never a silent send

veto_deadline_at is written ONCE via CAS (WHERE veto_deadline_at IS NULL) from immutable notification_deliveries.delivered_at, and never recomputed; the granted window is recorded as an append-only spine step with actor and granted-window detail
Four-condition opt-in (D20): absence of the persona='solicitation' policy row = auto lane off; rows written only through server routes (invariant #14)
Governor account-wide read: an active suspension on ANY auto_approval_policies row for the account blocks auto-approval (D19: the Governor needs zero code changes)
Invariant #2: the veto-notice enqueue rides the approving transaction via job_outbox; new topic gets a typed helper
Invariant #11: entitlement via subscriptionGrantsFullAccess, never a raw status compare
Judge availability stays a DISPATCH precondition owned by the releaser (#900 applyJudgeSplit); no approval-time Judge check
The veto-window-minutes value is read from the policy row at approval and recorded on the spine; later policy edits never move an in-flight window
edge_cases: All notice channels fail or none are enrolled ⇒ no anchor, batch expires via existing closure; systemic-failure log line (pending-post-notice precedent)
Judge down at the first release tick ⇒ existing applyJudgeSplit downgrades the auto batch — accepted churn, no approval-time duplication
One-active-send-batch index rejects the auto approval ⇒ batch stays built for owner review; the build transaction must not fail
Owner halts during the veto window, delivery confirmation arrives later ⇒ the anchor CAS must not resurrect a halted batch
Duplicate delivery webhooks ⇒ CAS is idempotent; the first delivered_at wins
Flag flips ON with built batches already waiting ⇒ no retroactive sweep
Policy row deleted between approval and release ⇒ release-time re-check downgrades (policy_removed)
Trialing account with Autopilot tier ⇒ full access per invariant #11 (subscriptionGrantsFullAccess treats trialing like active)

rollback_plan: Flag SOLICITATION_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED ships unset (default OFF) in every environment, so the lane lands inert. Back-out order if flipped: (1) unset the flag — the approval-time gate refuses new auto approvals and the release-time gate downgrades unreleased auto_policy batches to owner review; (2) migration 113 is index-only (outbox in-flight index + notification_deliveries claim index) — down = DROP INDEX both, no data movement; (3) code revert is a clean git revert (no columns added). Staging first, prod in lockstep per deployment-guide.
observability: Spine: an auto-approval step and a veto-window-grant step on the solicitation_send_batch parent run (append-only, with actor + granted window)
Release report: anchored + downgraded-by-reason counters per tick (extend ReleaseCycleReport)
Sentry warning on every release-time downgrade (existing DOWNGRADE_ALERT_MESSAGE single-issue pattern)
Veto-notice systemic-failure log line when zero channels deliver (pending-post-notice precedent)

How I know it broke: auto_policy batches whose veto_deadline_at stays NULL for more than one poller interval while notification_deliveries carries a delivered_at — visible in the release report counters
